name: StoreAgent – WooCommerce AI Plugin
author: Josh Kohlbach

sections.description:
StoreAgent.ai writes your WooCommerce product descriptions, tags, Q&A, and more — in seconds. No fluff. Just better product content that helps you sell.

Sign Up For StoreAgent. Claim your 500 free credits.

Most WooCommerce AI tools feel like you’re babysitting a chatbot. StoreAgent is different — it’s built specifically for WooCommerce product content. No fiddling with prompts, no copying and pasting between tools. Just smart, purpose-built features that live right inside your store and actually help you get stuff done — fast.

✍️ Write Better Product Pages, Faster
Say goodbye to writer’s block. Instantly generate high-converting descriptions, tags, short blurbs, and Q&A with AI — all tailored to your products.

🛒 Works Inside WooCommerce
No new dashboard to learn, no copy pasting or questionable Woo integration. StoreAgent is built directly into your product editor — just click, generate, and publish.

💼 Looks Like You Hired a Copywriter
Set the tone, tweak the vibe, and let StoreAgent match your brand voice — without ever touching a keyboard.

🚀 Always Getting Smarter
New content tools and improvements drop regularly, so your store stays fresh and ahead of the curve.

Get Started Free — No BS
Connect your store, claim your 500 free credits, and start creating better product content today. No subscription required.

Learn more at StoreAgent.ai

Key WooCommerce AI Features

StoreAgent gives store owners a growing toolbox of WooCommerce AI tools that take the grunt work out of product content. Whether you’re launching a new product or trying to clean up old listings, we’ve got you.

Here’s what’s inside:

  • 📝 Product Description Assistant – Forget blank pages. Instantly generate detailed, SEO-friendly product descriptions from just a few inputs.
  • ⚡ Short Description Generator – Need a quick blurb for your products? Let StoreAgent whip up a punchy, scroll-stopping short description that converts.
  • 🏷️ Tag Generator – Boost product visibility with smart, AI-generated tags that improve search and filtering.
  • ❓ Product Q&A – Let customers ask questions on product pages — StoreAgent generates answers, grows your knowledge base, and builds trust automatically.
  • ⭐ Review Summarizer – Lots of reviews on your products? StoreAgent creates review summaries that highlight customer sentiment and key takeaways.

What You Can Do With StoreAgent

💸 Save Time, Write Less
Ditch the hours spent writing content. StoreAgent handles it in seconds.

🧠 Look Smart, Sell More
Professional-quality content that sounds like you — but better. AI handles the hard part.

🔍 Get SEO Wins Without Lifting a Finger
Optimized product copy, tags, and summaries — baked in by default.

💬 Be There 24/7
Q&A answers your customers’ product questions even while you sleep.

Feedback and Support

If you encounter any issues or have feature suggestions, please reach out to us at support@storeagent.ai.

Have an idea for an AI tool? Let us know.
sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin zip file or install it directly from the WordPress Plugin Directory.
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress admin area.
  3. Click Upload Plugin and select the downloaded zip file (if installing manually).
  4. Click Install Now, then Activate the plugin.
  5. Go to StoreAgent > Settings to configure your AI agents and connect your StoreAgent.ai account.
sections.faq:
Do I need a StoreAgent.ai account to use this plugin?

Yes, an active StoreAgent.ai account is required. Sign up here.

Is this a free WooCommerce AI plugin?

Yes, StoreAgent.ai offers 500 free credits when you sign up so you can get started AI on your store for free. Loving what it does after that? Just pay for more credits.

Can I customize the AI tools?

Absolutely! You can fine-tune behavior and settings via the plugin dashboard.

Does this plugin work with all WooCommerce themes?

Yes, StoreAgent.ai is compatible with all WooCommerce-compliant themes.

How does this differ from other AI tools?

Most AI tools feel like you’re babysitting a chatbot. StoreAgent is different — it’s built specifically for WooCommerce product content. No fiddling with prompts, no copying and pasting between tools. Just smart, purpose-built features that live right inside your store and actually help you get stuff done — fast.
